decisions.evidence: run 0x5782b0-0x57af10 = the config.txt hardware-compat parser shipped with retail Halo PC (the game dir's config.txt literally contains the keywords 'Requirements', 'AudioVendor', 'break', CpuSpeed/Memory/VideoMemory/DirectX and the video-card quirk properties). 0x578ff0 evaluates D3DCAPS9 field names + GetVersionExA win95..winxp, 0x579690 is the '=='/'!='/'>='/'<=' tokenizer of the same grammar (Ghidra's 'gamespy_get_client_key_hash' is a bogus name - no GameSpy SDK routine, and no qr2/gp/sb/natneg strings). This is Gearbox PC-port engine code, not D3DX9/CRT/GameSpy/Bink/Vorbis, so lib:* is wrong. Module = shell for contiguity with the same subsystem's front end: 0x57d410/0x57d880 ('config.txt','ForceShader','Unknown property in config.txt', ddraw/DxDiag device detect) were already assigned shell (0.6) in assign_13, and they are reached from the Win32 startup run FUN_005411e0 (shell 0.58); parsed flags land in 0x722b__/0x6eff__ globals read by rasterizer_initialize 0x5169c0. rasterizer is the runner-up (the flags are mostly graphics quirks) but the parser also covers AudioVendor, CPU/memory/disk/DirectX requirements, which is startup/shell scope.
